conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Expect modest returns with reduced volatility.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It uses and adds leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is critical to manage potential rapid losses.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield.
